findings: RRLS transport discards locally generated SDK traffic but the worker logged successful acceptance as sent. Logs alone were not radio-transmission evidence.
RRLS startup seeded writable GS-owned managed-variable defaults despite its observer role.
BMP390 model held non-latched DRDY until a data read instead of expiring after 2.5ms.
Default descending conversion timer retained its initial count when the configured ODR shortened the period.
Service-style raw UART startup left the primary recovery layer disabled when GS_RRLS_ROLE was absent; the simulator injected primary and concealed the mismatch.
changes: RRLS uses read-only managed variables without local GS defaults; per-packet FLIGHT_STATE logging is debug-level and says accepted.
Serial smoke test checks actual RRLS output framing, with a nonempty observation requirement.
Model implements non-latched pulse expiration, read-clear interrupt status, latched behavior, and explicit ascending conversion timers.
FC continues barometer acquisition/publication when IMU prediction is incomplete, during postinit, and while awaiting ignition acceptance. DRDY level recovery observes each high pulse once.
Raw UART main-station startup now defaults to primary; explicit off remains supported. Simulator RRLS profiles and the real-backend serial test no longer inject a primary role.
